description: API-backed adversarial full-run validation cases for MODAL-ASO production readiness.

cases.description: Missing target context must pause before design, then resume with the user supplied context.
cases.request: Design steric splice-switching ASOs for human SMN2 exon 7 inclusion. Return at least 20 candidates per site.

clarification_answers.answer: Human spinal cord motor neurons in an SMA in vitro model.

Use biologically distinct exon 7 inclusion-relevant steric target regions: the exon 7 acceptor-proximal junction, the exon 7 donor-proximal junction, and the intron 7 ISS-N1/donor-proximal downstream silencer window. For the acceptor site use 25 nt upstream in intron 6 plus the first 25 nt of exon 7. For the donor site use the last 10 nt of exon 7 plus 60 nt downstream into intron 7. For ISS-N1 use donor +1 to +60 downstream if the exact motif span is unavailable.
ASOs may bind intronic pre-mRNA sequence. Use exon plus adjacent intronic flanks for the donor, acceptor, and ISS-N1/downstream silencer windows.
Use ENST00000626847 as the exon 7 skipped isoform to decrease and ENST00000380743 as the exon 7 included isoform to increase.

cases.description: SMN2 exon 7 inclusion should target exon 7 donor/acceptor/ISS-N1 biology and avoid the older wrong upstream anchor.
cases.request: Design steric splice-switching ASOs for human SMN2 in human spinal cord motor neurons in an SMA in vitro model to convert Ensembl transcript ENST00000626847, the exon 7 skipped isoform, toward Ensembl transcript ENST00000380743 by increasing exon 7 inclusion. Return at least 20 ASOs per site. Use biologically distinct exon 7 inclusion-relevant steric target regions: the intron 7 ISS-N1/donor-proximal downstream silencer region, the exon 7 donor-proximal junction region, and the exon 7 acceptor-proximal junction region. For the acceptor site use 25 nt upstream in intron 6 plus the first 25 nt of exon 7. For the donor site use the last 10 nt of exon 7 plus 60 nt downstream into intron 7. If an exact ISS-N1 motif span is available, include the donor +1 to +60 downstream window as the ISS-N1 route.

clarification_answers.answer: Use ENST00000626847 as the exon 7 skipped isoform to decrease and ENST00000380743 as the exon 7 included isoform to increase.

expect.qualitative_focus: Routes should be exon 7 inclusion routes, not a broad list of untargetable SMN2 splice sites.

cases.description: LMNA request should preserve progerin-reduction and Lamin A/C preservation objectives.
cases.request: Design steric splice-switching ASOs for human LMNA in HGPS patient dermal fibroblasts to reduce the pathogenic progerin isoform while preserving normal Lamin A and Lamin C isoforms. Use the LMNA exon 11/progerin cryptic splice context and return the ranked candidate set with off-target expression annotation.

clarification_answers.answer: Accept the suggested isoform transcript IDs: use ENST00000368299 for progerin, ENST00000368300 for Lamin A, and ENST00000368301 for Lamin C.

expect.qualitative_focus: Routes should be justified by progerin/Lamin A/C isoform balance, not generic LMNA knockdown.

cases.description: Figure 6 LMNA request should produce several isoform-balancing splice routes, not only the progerin cryptic donor.
cases.request: Design steric splice-switching ASOs for human LMNA in human fibroblasts. I want to decrease the progerin isoform of LMNA as top priority with SSOs, and increase the isoform represented by SnapGene file ~/lamina.dna and the Lamin C isoform. If ~/lamina.dna is unavailable, ask which isoform it represents rather than assuming. Return ranked candidate sets for each targetable splice route with off-target expression annotation.

clarification_answers.answer: The SnapGene file is unavailable in this validation run; use Lamin A / ENST00000368300 as the isoform represented by ~/lamina.dna.

Use ENST00000368299 for progerin, ENST00000368300 for the Lamin A/SnapGene isoform, and ENST00000368301 for Lamin C. Do not use ENST00000368300 for Lamin C. Decrease progerin and increase Lamin A/SnapGene plus Lamin C.
Use human HGPS patient dermal fibroblasts as the biological target context.

expect.qualitative_focus: Routes should resemble the Figure 6 LMNA route set: exon 10 donor, exon 11 acceptor, progerin donor, exon 12 acceptor, and possible Lamin A donor context.

cases.description: MAPT exon 10 modulation should produce separate donor and acceptor route outputs for exon exclusion.
cases.request: Design steric splice-switching ASOs for human MAPT in human iPSC-derived cortical neurons to reduce MAPT exon 10 inclusion and favor exon 10 exclusion. Evaluate donor and acceptor splice-site windows as separate target routes, not a shared combined route, and return 20 candidates for each route.

clarification_answers.answer: Use ENST00000446361 for the exon 10-included 4R MAPT transcript to decrease.
Use ENST00000334239 for the exon 10-skipped/3R MAPT transcript to increase.
Use two separate exon 10 routes: an acceptor-proximal window and a donor-proximal window. Do not merge them into one shared route.
Use ENST00000446361 as the exon 10-included 4R MAPT transcript to decrease and ENST00000334239 as the exon 10-skipped/3R MAPT transcript to increase. Use ENST00000446361 for exon 10 site mapping.

expect.qualitative_focus: The generated ASO set should reflect exclusion-focused MAPT exon 10 donor and acceptor route bins.

cases.description: PCCA poison exon request should preserve explicit hg38 target span and separate donor/acceptor routes.
cases.request: Design steric splice-switching ASOs for human PCCA in human hepatocyte-like cells to promote skipping of the PCCA poison exon at hg38 chr13:100305751-100305834 (+) and recover productive PCCA mRNA. Evaluate the poison-exon acceptor and donor target-site routes separately and return the top 20 ASOs for each route.

clarification_answers.answer: Use hg38 chr13:100305751-100305834 on the plus strand as the PCCA poison exon span.

cases.description: CDKN1B target-site blocker request should use only the four explicit manuscript intervals.
cases.request: Design 20-nt steric ASOs for human CDKN1B in HEK293T in vitro cells to block PUM1/eCLIP site 1 chr12:12721313-12721416 (+), PUM1/eCLIP site 2 chr12:12721400-12721460 (+), miR-221/miR-222 seed window 1 chr12:12721208-12721253 (+), and miR-221/miR-222 seed window 2 chr12:12721281-12721326 (+). Use hg38 and accept any overlap with each site.

expect.qualitative_focus: Candidate intervals should be bounded by the four supplied target-site intervals; the model should not substitute old names or unrelated CDKN1B regions.

cases.description: Mixed genome-build coordinates should trigger clarification instead of silently merging incompatible spans.
cases.request: Design steric ASOs for human CDKN1B in HEK293T cells using hg19 chr12:12721208-12721253 for one regulatory site and hg38 chr12:12721313-12721416 for a second regulatory site. Use any overlap with each site.

expect.qualitative_focus: The platform should ask the user to resolve the coordinate build conflict before tiling.

cases.description: Versioned transcript requests should lock the base transcript and preserve the version metadata.
cases.request: Design steric splice-switching ASOs for human LRRK2 in human iPSC-derived dopaminergic neurons to decrease inclusion of exon 27 in Ensembl transcript ENST00000298910.12. Keep that transcript choice locked and do not silently switch to another isoform.

clarification_answers.answer: Use ENST00000298910.12 exactly as the user-specified transcript lock; normalize the base ID to ENST00000298910 and preserve version 12 metadata.

cases.description: Impossible constraints should produce a truthful no-candidates/constraint-exhausted result, not fabricated candidates.
cases.request: Design 20-nt gapmer ASOs for human CDKN1B in HEK293T in vitro cells, but constrain candidates to hg38 chr12:12721208-12721217 (+), require GC content exactly 50%, exclude G homopolymer runs of length 1 or greater, and require at most one total binding site. Return 50 candidates if feasible.

expect.qualitative_focus: The correct behavior is graceful infeasibility or an explicit clarification; it must not invent 20 nt ASOs from a 10 bp required region.

cases.description: Large composite request should remain a structured task graph without collapsing independent contexts.
cases.request: Run separate MODAL-ASO design programs and one synthesis for these independent goals: human LMNA steric ASOs in HGPS dermal fibroblasts to reduce progerin while preserving Lamin A/C; human MAPT steric ASOs in iPSC-derived cortical neurons to reduce exon 10 inclusion; human CDKN1B 20-nt steric ASOs in HEK293T cells to block the four hg38 target-site intervals chr12:12721313-12721416, chr12:12721400-12721460, chr12:12721208-12721253, and chr12:12721281-12721326 with any overlap. Compare the generated candidate sets and write one synthesis.

clarification_answers.answer: For the LMNA child design, reduce progerin and preserve Lamin A/C in HGPS dermal fibroblasts.
For the MAPT child design, reduce exon 10 inclusion in human iPSC-derived cortical neurons.
For the CDKN1B child design, use the four provided hg38 intervals exactly and allow any overlap.

expect.qualitative_focus: The task graph should keep three independent design programs and compare their actual candidate outputs.

cases.description: A missing isolated reference root should ask for download approval and run the download path.
cases.request: Design human PCSK9 gapmer ASOs in HepG2 hepatocyte cells to reduce PCSK9 expression.

cases.description: Live goal intake must use exact executable constraint keys for GC, off-target binding limits, and base-specific homopolymer limits.
cases.request: Design human LRRK2 gapmer ASOs in iPSC-derived dopaminergic neurons with GC content greater than 35% and less than 65%, fewer than 3 total off-target mappings, and exclude sequences with G homopolymer runs of length 4 or greater.

cases.description: Candidate design run should emit a GenBank export users can open in SnapGene-compatible tooling.
cases.request: Design human PCSK9 gapmer ASOs in HepG2 hepatocyte cells to reduce PCSK9 expression and export the ranked ASO candidates as a GenBank file.
